name: water-brush-slope-shallow
description: one Shallow Water click, size 3, on sloping ground (fixtures/we-specs/slope.w3x, the ground rising 6 world units a corner along x), at the same screen position in both editors (the terrain view at the editor's opening camera): the editor sets the ground of the 47 corners within 4 of the click (13 water corners and a rim of 34) to the clicked corner's height, gives the 37 water and rim corners Grass Cliff (1, the palette's start) and the 24 dry ones of them the water's level word too; Studio does the same (2026-11-13)

name: water-brush-slope-deep
description: the same with the Deep Water brush

name: water-brush-slope-shallow-east
description: the Shallow brush 100 px east of the middle, where the clicked corner's ground is 48 and its neighbours' 0 to 144: the editor sets all 47 corners to 48 (so the height is the clicked corner's, not the rim's nearest or the mean), and the 24 dry corners round the water get its level word (8240)
